'''Kenton''' (Japanese: '''ケンタ''' ''Kenta'') is a minor recurring character of {{aniseries|BW}}.

==History==
Kenton debuted in ''[[BW090|Jostling for the Junior Cup!]]'', where he participated in the [[Pokémon World Tournament Junior Cup]] and was [[Manning]]'s first opponent. However, he was defeated by him and eliminated from the tournament. He made a cameo appearance in ''[[BW093|Goodbye, Junior Cup - Hello Adventure!]]'', where he lined up with all the other competitors in front of [[Alder]], [[Cynthia]], [[Caitlin]] and [[Freddy O'Martian]].

In ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'', Kenton competed in the [[Vertress Conference]]. In ''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]'', he appeared on the screen showing the match-ups for the second round of the Conference, meaning that he had made it through the first round. In ''[[BW105|Lost at the League!]]'', he appeared once again on the screen of the Vertress Conference, now showing the match-ups for the last sixteen, meaning he had made it through the second and third rounds. In the fourth round, he battled {{un|Cameron}} and used his {{p|Gigalith}} to battle Cameron's {{p|Riolu}}. Cameron won and Kenton was eliminated from the tournament, placing him in the Top 16. In ''[[BW108|A Unova League Evolution!]]'', he appeared once again during the closing ceremonies of the Vertress Conference.
